claim: Pending explicit original 16-/8-monomial coordinate-ring bases and exact finite/overlap/infinity compatibility, without an H1 dimension or spanning claim.
status: Revision r2: tensor operand parsing repair; hosted strict checking, axiom audit and independent acceptance pending.

obligations.name: Original quadratic presentation
obligations.required: Construct actual one/root basis of RootRing a, not a basis of an unidentified quadratic algebra.
obligations.constructed: rootBasis maps QuadraticAlgebra.basis a 0 through presentationEquiv a.
obligations.justification: The existing algebra equivalence sends omega to the actual AdjoinRoot root. rootBasis_apply identifies both indexed entries.

obligations.name: Full finite index coverage
obligations.constructed: FourIndex=(Fin 2 times Fin 2) times (Fin 2 times Fin 2); ThreeIndex=Fin 2 times (Fin 2 times Fin 2).
obligations.justification: Each factor is the complete quadratic basis. Tensor product of bases produces all sixteen or eight independent coefficients without selecting a subset.

obligations.name: Original tensor carriers
obligations.required: The bases must use the existing parenthesization and ring objects.
obligations.constructed: fourBasis targets FourRootOrder318.Order a; threeBasis targets ThreeRootOrder318.Order a.
obligations.justification: Their tensor parenthesizations match the existing definitions exactly; no regrouping or implicit coordinate permutation is inserted.

obligations.name: Named generator identification
obligations.required: Basis entries must coincide with the already constructed root generators.
obligations.constructed: fourBasis_monomial and threeBasis_monomial express every entry as products of original named generators with exponents zero or one.
obligations.justification: The proofs use tensor multiplication and the explicit one/root factor bases. This supplies a concrete monomial identity, not merely a dimension count.

obligations.name: Coefficient changes
obligations.required: Base-changing the order must preserve each original basis monomial.
obligations.constructed: four_coefficientMap and three_coefficientMap use the existing literal coefficientMap constructions.
obligations.justification: The earlier generator compatibility theorems apply to every named generator; map_mul and map_pow then give each complete monomial. No additional scalar factor appears.

obligations.name: Actual chart rings and bases
obligations.required: Specialize to the original finite, overlap and infinity orders over their original base rings.
obligations.constructed: finiteBasis, overlapBasis and infinityBasis target ContactKummerOrder318.SourceOrder c, ContactKummerOrder318.OpenOrder c and InfinityOpenChart318.OpenOrder c.
obligations.justification: Their coefficient rings remain Q[t], the original contact localization and the original infinity localization, respectively. These are not rational vector-space bases.

obligations.name: Actual transition and complete expansion
obligations.required: The original finite restriction must preserve monomials and the expansions must cover whole rings.
obligations.constructed: finite_to_overlap uses SourceOpenFractionField318.orderToOpen; three expansion theorems use each actual basis repr.
obligations.justification: orderToOpen is the exact earlier coefficient-change map. Basis.sum_repr gives all ring elements and all finite indices; no small monomial subspace replaces the carrier.

obligations.name: Infinity normalization and original field
obligations.required: The infinity basis must embed through the original infinity-to-contact field map with exact scalars.
obligations.constructed: infinity_embedding sends each basis vector to the product of the original ratios root(j+1)/root(0).
obligations.justification: It uses InfinityOrderCoordinates318.generator_embedding for all three original generators, preserving the original field and normalization. No guessed field isomorphism or rational scaling is used.

obligations.name: Consumer boundary, history and verification
obligations.required: Do not infer H1 dimension or spanning from finite-free ranks of coordinate rings.
obligations.constructed: This packet supplies explicit coefficient-ring bases for the separately identified source-H1 coordinate quotient.
obligations.justification: The original sources already proved finite freeness and ranks; this continuation exports concrete monomial bases and exact transition identities. No H1 quotient calculation, Q-linear H1 action, fivefold spanning or isogeny follows yet. Hosted strict checking and independent acceptance are pending; no local Lean run occurred.
